title: Warm-up
description:
Every CTF starts here. The flag format is flag{...}.
The flag for this example challenge is: flag{example_warmup_not_a_real_flag}

title: Published as a hash
description: This challenge stores only the SHA-256 of the flag, so the challenge file can be shared publicly. (For this example the flag is flag{example_hashed_not_real}.) Create a digest with: ctfhost hash-flag
